Ms D v Delta Services — Reserved Judgment

Case number
2400789/2024
Decision date
30 June 2024
Jurisdiction code
Unfair Dismissal, Discrimination
Decision
Claim succeeds on discrimination head.

Reasons

The principal complaint here is direct discrimination under the Equality Act 2010, with harassment and victimisation also pleaded. The dismissal is the act of detriment relied upon, but the Equality Act 2010 framework — direct discrimination, indirect discrimination, victimisation, harassment — dominates the reasoning. The unfair-dismissal head was withdrawn at the start of the hearing.

We find the Equality Act 2010 claim well-founded.
